<style>.rp{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:0;cursor:pointer;color:#fff;font:700 15px Inter,sans-serif;background:var(--accent,#3366FF);padding:15px 30px;border-radius:12px}
.rp .r{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);width:16px;height:16px;
 transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(0);animation:rip .7s ease-out forwards;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes rip{to{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(16);opacity:0}}</style>
<button class="rp" id="rp">Tap me</button>
<script>var b=document.getElementById('rp');
function ripple(x,y){var s=document.createElement('span');s.className='r';s.style.left=x+'px';s.style.top=y+'px';b.appendChild(s);setTimeout(function(){s.remove();},700);}
b.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){var r=b.getBoundingClientRect();ripple(e.clientX-r.left,e.clientY-r.top);});
setInterval(function(){var r=b.getBoundingClientRect();ripple(r.width/2,r.height/2);},1600);</script>
